ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the horizontal axis in the figure is the horizontal distance of the slope surface, representing different positions from the upper slope to the lower slope; the curve in the figure generally declines as distance increases, and the black shading represents the change in slope surface erosion amount. The shading mainly appears in the middle and lower parts of the slope surface, indicating that erosion intensity differs among different slope sections on the same slope surface, and that the erosion problem occurs on the slope surface itself. Then reason: the question stem states that precipitation, infiltration intensity, and slope surface texture are consistent in the downslope direction, so the erosion difference mainly comes from slope-section position and the slope surface runoff process. From the angle of the information in this figure, small watershed management on the Loess Plateau should focus on treating slope surface sections that are vulnerable to erosion, so one of the most important measures is slope protection.

一个坡面在顺坡方向降水、入渗强度、坡面质地一致的情况下，不同坡段侵蚀量也不相同。该图表示侵蚀量在坡面上的变化。读图回答：从该图信息所示角度考虑，黄土高原小流域治理最重要的措施之一是什么？

The shading mainly appears in the middle and lower parts of the slope surface, indicating that erosion intensity differs among different slope sections on the same slope surface, and that the erosion problem occurs on the slope surface itself. Then reason: the question stem states that precipitation, infiltration intensity, and slope surface texture are consistent in the downslope direction, so the erosion difference mainly comes from slope-section position and the slope surface runoff process. From the angle of the information in this figure, small watershed management on the Loess Plateau should focus on treating slope surface sections that are vulnerable to erosion, so one of the most important measures is slope protection.
